name: com.igp.custom-unity-cli
description: Static declaration of the cucli surface. The 'offline' section is served by Tools/cucli.ps1 itself. The 'groups' section is generated from the compiled Editor worker by 'cucli commands export' so that 'cucli commands list' works even while Unity is closed; an empty array only degrades offline listing, never dispatch. Project-local commands are deliberately NOT written here: they go to registry.local.json inside the project's extension area, outside this package, so project code can never be published with the package.

actions.summary: Add a scoped registry to Packages/manifest.json (the file is backed up first).

actions.name: remove_registry
actions.summary: Remove a scoped registry from Packages/manifest.json (the file is backed up first).

actions.name: resolve_packages
actions.summary: Ask the Package Manager to re-resolve the project manifest.

force.description: action=remove_package: remove even when other packages depend on it.

offline.description: action=list_packages: use the local cache instead of the network.

groups.name: prefab
groups.summary: Prefab 资产：从场景物体创建、读取信息与层级、在隔离上下文中修改内容，以及 Prefab Stage 的打开/保存/关闭。

actions.name: create_from_gameobject
actions.summary: 把场景或 Prefab Stage 中的物体保存为 prefab 资产（需要 force 才能覆盖已存在资产）。

actions.name: get_info
actions.summary: 读取 prefab 资产信息：guid、类型、根物体、组件类型、子物体数、是否 Variant。

actions.name: get_hierarchy
actions.summary: 分页列出 prefab 内部的全部节点（路径为 A/B/C 形式）。

actions.name: modify_contents
actions.summary: 在 LoadPrefabContents 事务中修改 prefab 内容：改名、transform、父节点、组件、增删子物体。

actions.name: open_prefab_stage
actions.summary: 在 Prefab Stage（可交互编辑态）中打开 prefab。

actions.name: save_prefab_stage
actions.summary: 保存当前 Prefab Stage 的内容。

actions.name: close_prefab_stage
actions.summary: 退出 Prefab Stage，可选先保存。

prefabPath.description: prefab 资产路径，必须位于 Assets/ 下；path 为别名。

target.description: create 时是场景/Prefab Stage 内的源物体；modify 时是 prefab 内部 A/B/C 路径或名称。

name.description: create 时是 target 的别名；modify 时是重命名的新名。

searchInactive.description: action=create_from_gameobject：源物体查找是否包含 inactive。

force.description: action=create_from_gameobject：覆盖已存在的 prefab 资产。

parent.description: action=modify_contents：prefab 内新父物体名/路径；空串表示置根。

componentsToAdd.description: 元素为类型名或 { typeName, properties }。

componentProperties.description: { 组件名: { 属性: 值 } }；任一失败则整体不保存。

createChild.description: 子物体定义对象或对象数组（name / parent / sourcePrefabPath / primitiveType / transform / componentsToAdd / tag / layer / setActive）。

deleteChild.description: 相对 target 的子物体路径：字符串、字符串数组或 { name }。

groups.name: refresh
groups.summary: Refresh assets, trigger or await script compilation, reimport specific paths, and wait for the Editor to become idle.

actions.name: assets
actions.summary: Rescan the asset database (AssetDatabase.Refresh).

actions.name: compile
actions.summary: Request script compilation and, by default, wait until it finishes.

actions.name: reimport
actions.summary: Force-reimport specific asset paths.

actions.name: wait
actions.summary: Block until the Editor is idle: not compiling and not importing.

actions.name: status
actions.summary: Report compile/import state and the first compilation error, if any.

wait.description: action=compile: wait for compilation to finish.

requireCompileSuccess.description: action=wait: fail if the last compilation had errors.

groups.name: scene
groups.summary: 场景管理：创建、加载、保存、关闭、切换激活、层级浏览、Build Settings、截图、框选与校验。

actions.name: create
actions.summary: 新建场景（empty / default / 3d_basic / 2d_basic 模板，默认 Assets/Scenes/<name>.unity）。

actions.name: load
actions.summary: 按 path / name / buildIndex 加载场景；当前场景有未保存改动时按 MCP 语义拒绝加载。

actions.name: save
actions.summary: 保存指定或当前场景，可另存到新的 path。

actions.name: get_hierarchy
actions.summary: 分页列出场景根节点或某个父物体的直接子级（含 inactive、组件类型、可选 transform）。

actions.name: get_active
actions.summary: 报告当前活动场景的名称、路径、buildIndex、脏标记与根节点数量。

actions.name: get_build_settings
actions.summary: 列出 EditorBuildSettings 中的场景（path / guid / enabled / buildIndex）。

actions.name: screenshot
actions.summary: 截图（game_view 或 scene_view、相机/定位/包围盒批量环绕），写出 PNG 资产，可选内联 base64。

actions.name: scene_view_frame
actions.summary: 在 SceneView 中框选目标物体或整个场景。

actions.name: close_scene
actions.summary: 关闭已加载场景；只剩一个场景或场景有未保存改动时拒绝。

actions.name: set_active_scene
actions.summary: 把某个已加载场景设为活动场景。

actions.name: get_loaded_scenes
actions.summary: 列出全部已加载场景及其状态。

actions.name: move_to_scene
actions.summary: 把一个根 GameObject 移动到另一个已加载场景。

actions.name: validate
actions.summary: 校验活动场景中的 Missing Script 与丢失引用的 prefab，可选自动修复 Missing Script。

name.description: action=create / save / load / close_scene / set_active_scene / move_to_scene：场景名。

path.description: action=create / load / save：目录或 .unity 资产路径（Assets/ 下）。

buildIndex.description: action=load：Build Settings 索引，与 path/name 二选一。

force.description: action=create：覆盖同名场景并丢弃未保存改动。

includeImage.description: action=screenshot：是否内联 base64 图片。

maxResolution.description: action=screenshot：内联图片长边上限，0 表示默认 640。

camera.description: action=screenshot：Camera 的 name / hierarchy path / instanceID（scene_view 下禁止）。

sceneViewTarget.description: action=scene_view_frame：要框选的物体（GO 引用）。

parent.description: action=get_hierarchy：列出该物体的直接子级；省略则列出场景根节点。

maxDepth.description: action=get_hierarchy：当前分页模式只返回一层，仅为兼容回显。

sceneName.description: action=close_scene / set_active_scene / move_to_scene：已加载场景名。

scenePath.description: action=close_scene / set_active_scene / move_to_scene：已加载场景路径。

removeScene.description: action=close_scene：true 从内存移除，false 仅卸载。

target.description: action=move_to_scene：根 GameObject 的 name / path / instanceID。

groups.name: script
groups.summary: Create, read, edit, validate, hash and delete C# scripts under Assets/.

actions.name: create
actions.summary: Create a .cs file from a template or explicit contents.

actions.name: read
actions.summary: Read a slice of a script: line range and maximum characters.

actions.name: update
actions.summary: Deprecated alias of apply_text_edits (whole-file overwrite with the given contents).

actions.name: edit
actions.summary: Structured edits: replace/delete class or method, anchor insert/delete/replace.

actions.name: apply_text_edits
actions.summary: Replace exact line/column ranges, guarded by a precondition SHA-256.

actions.name: validate
actions.summary: Structural validation: bracket balance, using/namespace consistency, duplicate members.

actions.name: get_sha
actions.summary: Report the SHA-256 of the file contents.

actions.name: delete
actions.summary: Move a script to the OS trash. Requires force=true.

name.description: 类名或文件名，拼成 {name}.cs；须匹配 ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$。

path.description: 相对 Assets/ 的目录；空时默认 Scripts。

encodedContents.description: contentsEncoded=true 时的 base64 正文。

scriptType.description: action=create: MonoBehaviour / ScriptableObject / Editor / EditorWindow / Plain。

namespace.description: action=create: 生成模板的外层 namespace。

maxChars.description: action=read: 返回内容的最大字符数。

groups.name: shader
groups.summary: Create, read, update and delete .shader files, with URP and Built-in templates.

actions.name: create
actions.summary: Create a .shader file from the URP or Built-in template, or explicit contents.

actions.name: read
actions.summary: Read a shader file: line range and maximum characters.

actions.name: update
actions.summary: Replace a shader file's contents.

actions.name: delete
actions.summary: Move a shader file to the OS trash. Requires force=true.

path.description: 相对 Assets/ 的目录；空时默认 Shaders。

groups.name: so
groups.summary: Create and patch ScriptableObject assets: create/create_so, modify/modify_so, with dryRun validation.

actions.name: create
actions.summary: Create a ScriptableObject asset from a type name plus optional patches.

actions.name: create_so
actions.summary: Alias of create (MCP spelling).

actions.name: modify
actions.summary: Patch serialized properties on an existing ScriptableObject asset.

actions.name: modify_so
actions.summary: Alias of modify (MCP spelling).

typeName.description: action=create: ScriptableObject type name or full name.

folderPath.description: action=create: Assets/ 下的目标目录.

assetName.description: action=create: 文件名，可省略 .asset 后缀.

overwrite.description: action=create: 已存在时原地覆盖（保留 GUID）.

target.description: action=modify: {guid|path} 定位目标资产，guid 优先.

patches.description: 补丁数组，每项含 propertyPath、op 与 value。

groups.name: test
groups.summary: Unity Test Framework: start an EditMode or PlayMode run, poll its progress and failures, read the results.

actions.name: status
actions.summary: Poll a test job by jobId: progress, stuck detection and the first failures.

actions.name: run
actions.summary: Start a test run. Returns jobId immediately; at most one job runs at a time.

actions.name: result
actions.summary: Read the finished summary and the individual test cases (paged).

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List the retained test jobs (at most 10). Paged.

actions.name: cancel
actions.summary: Mark the current test job as cancelled (Unity cannot abort a run in flight).

includeFailedTests.description: Return only the cases that did not pass.

clearStuck.description: action=run: clear the stuck job instead of starting one.

groups.name: texture
groups.summary: Create and edit texture assets: fill, sprite, modify, delete, pattern, gradient, noise and import settings.

actions.name: create
actions.summary: Create a texture from a fill colour, a pattern, explicit pixels or an image file.

actions.name: create_sprite
actions.summary: Create a texture and configure it as a Sprite.

actions.name: modify
actions.summary: Edit a pixel region and/or change the import settings of an existing texture.

actions.name: delete
actions.summary: Delete a texture asset. Requires force=true.

actions.name: apply_pattern
actions.summary: Rewrite a texture with a checker / stripes / grid / dots / brick pattern.

actions.name: apply_gradient
actions.summary: Rewrite a texture with a linear or radial gradient.

actions.name: apply_noise
actions.summary: Rewrite a texture with perlin or value noise.

actions.name: set_import_settings
actions.summary: Write TextureImporter settings on an existing texture.

path.description: 资产路径，会自动补 Assets/ 前缀。

imagePath.description: 从磁盘图片加载（绝对路径或相对工程根）。

pattern.description: checker / checkerboard / stripes / stripes_v / stripes_h / stripes_diag / dots / grid / brick。

pixels.description: 整图逐像素：颜色数组，或以 base64: 前缀给出的原始 RGBA32 字节。

spriteSettings.description: {pivot, pixelsPerUnit}；旧版 Sprite 设置入口。

groups.name: ui
groups.summary: UI Toolkit work: UXML/USS files, UIDocument wiring, PanelSettings and VisualElement editing (no uGUI, no RectTransform).

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Round-trip probe reporting UI Toolkit availability and asset counts.

actions.name: create
actions.summary: Create a .uxml or .uss file. Fails when the file already exists.

actions.name: read
actions.summary: Read a .uxml or .uss file as text, optionally base64 encoded.

actions.name: update
actions.summary: Overwrite an existing .uxml or .uss file.

actions.name: attach_ui_document
actions.summary: Attach or update a UIDocument on a GameObject: visualTreeAsset, panelSettings, sortingOrder.

actions.name: create_panel_settings
actions.summary: Create a PanelSettings .asset with scale mode, reference resolution and sorting order.

actions.name: update_panel_settings
actions.summary: Write properties onto an existing PanelSettings .asset.

actions.name: get_visual_tree
actions.summary: Dump the UIDocument visual tree, depth limited and item limited.

actions.name: render_ui
actions.summary: Render the panel to a PNG under Assets/Docs~ and register it as an artifact.

actions.name: link_stylesheet
actions.summary: Insert a <Style src=...> reference for a USS asset into a UXML file.

actions.name: delete
actions.summary: Delete a .uxml or .uss file. Requires force.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List UXML, USS and PanelSettings assets, paged.

actions.name: detach_ui_document
actions.summary: Clear the UIDocument source asset on a GameObject.

actions.name: modify_visual_element
actions.summary: Set text, inline style, USS classes, enabled/visible and tooltip on a named element.

path.description: UXML/USS path for create/read/update/delete/link_stylesheet, .asset path for create_panel_settings/update_panel_settings, search folder for list.

contentsEncoded.description: action=create / update: decode encodedContents as base64.

target.description: GameObject name, hierarchy path or instance id hosting the UIDocument.

maxResolution.description: action=render_ui: longest side of the inlined image.

fileName.description: action=render_ui: output file name; '.png' is appended when missing.

outputFolder.description: action=render_ui: output folder; defaults to Assets/Docs~/.

force.description: action=render_ui / delete: overwrite or confirm a destructive change.

elementName.description: action=modify_visual_element: UXML name attribute, resolved with rootVisualElement.Q(name).

text.description: action=modify_visual_element: TextElement text; errors on a non-TextElement.

style.description: action=modify_visual_element: inline style dictionary (camelCase or kebab-case keys).

visible.description: action=modify_visual_element: 'true'/'1' maps to display=Flex, anything else to display=None.
